headline: UDP Demands Power Rate Rollback; PM Points to Past Neglect
summary: The United Democratic Party is demanding an immediate rollback of the latest electricity rate increase approved by the Public Utilities Commission. The Prime Minister has pointed to past neglect.
why: Electricity tariffs set by Belize's regulator affect household costs, business operating expenses and inflation in the country.
